name: RAD51 recombinase

function.text: RAD51 encodes DNA repair protein RAD51 homolog 1. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA strand exchange activity. It participates in DNA repair and telomere maintenance via recombination.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Fanconi anemia complementation group R (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Labcorp Genetics (formerly Invitae). Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

selection_reason: Panel membership; user authorized the complete proposed and reserve roster.
